How it works

FAQ

Common questions

Which exam boards do you cover?

Content is tailored to whichever exam board the student's school uses (AQA, Edexcel, OCR and others) for GCSE Maths, Combined Science, Triple Science, Business Studies, and A-level Maths, Economics and Philosophy. Each subject page lists what's covered.

What grades did you get?

A* in Economics and A* in Philosophy, and an A in Maths, including 196/200 across the AQA Philosophy papers and 96% in Paper 3 of Edexcel A Economics. At GCSE, grades 8 and 9 across 10 subjects. I sat all of these recently, so the specs and mark schemes I teach from are the current ones.

Do you tutor students younger than GCSE?

Yes, KS3 Maths and Science (Years 7–9), at the same rates as GCSE, tailored to what the student's covering in school.

Are sessions online or in person?

Online only, held via Google Meet. No travel time, and easy to fit around school and other commitments.

What happens after the free intro call?

If it's a good fit, you book a block of five weekly sessions. There's no obligation to continue after the call itself.

How does payment work, and what if I need to cancel?

Blocks of five are paid upfront, before the sessions begin. Cancel before a block starts for a full refund. Once a block is underway, any sessions not yet taken are refunded; sessions already delivered are not. Full details are on the pricing page.
